fix.home: Home computes _latest_no_priority_submission_id(journey) from the durable derived_states (analysis_without_priority.submission_ids, max). When no unresolved submission_result exists and the session acknowledgement equals the latest durable no-priority submission id, Home resets the current step to 1 Write and the primary action to a fresh Writing action (Open Writing). A newer unresolved submission never matches; without exact evidence the durable contract is kept.

root_cause: Home derives its current step and action contract exclusively from the durable journey state (feedback_no_practice_target -> step 2). The C1 finish action recorded a session acknowledgement (no_priority_reviewed) and cleared submission_result, but Home never consulted the acknowledgement for step/CTA derivation, so a completed cycle left Home at the durable feedback step.
